name: nortedesk
description: MVP de suporte remoto consentido (estilo AnyDesk)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nortedesk/protocol && concurrently -n protocol,signaling,desktop -c blue,green,magenta "npm run build:watch -w @nortedesk/protocol" "npm run dev -w @nortedesk/signaling" "npm run dev -w @nortedesk/desktop"
scripts.dev:signaling: npm run build -w @nortedesk/protocol && npm run dev -w @nortedesk/signaling
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build -w @nortedesk/protocol && npm run dev -w @nortedesk/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nortedesk/protocol && npm run build -w @nortedesk/signaling && npm run build -w @nortedesk/desktop
scripts.build:signaling: npm run build -w @nortedesk/protocol && npm run build -w @nortedesk/signaling
scripts.test: npm run test -w @nortedesk/protocol && npm run test -w @nortedesk/signaling && npm run test -w @nortedesk/desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build -w @nortedesk/protocol && npm run dist:win -w @nortedesk/desktop
